tasks.title: Homepage: Hero + new Quick Contact section
tasks.success: Hero re-skinned with Caprasimo headline, decorative rotating rings (CSS @keyframes, hidden below 860px, prefers-reduced-motion disables them); new Quick Contact section immediately after hero with 2-col layout (copy+trust bullets left, 4-field form right in .card/.elev-md) collapsing to 1-col below 860px; form uses contact-form-modern class and name/email/phone/message field names only.
tasks.verify: npm run dev; load homepage, confirm hero renders with animation and prefers-reduced-motion (devtools emulation) disables it; confirm Quick Contact appears right after hero; resize below 860px to confirm stacking + hero art hidden; check form field name attributes match handler's collectFormData keys (name/email/phone/message) without submitting live.
tasks.notes: Hero: eyebrow tag + 3 trust bullets grounded in existing site copy (no invented stats), decorative rings/8-mark/floating chips via CSS keyframes, hidden below 768px (site's existing breakpoint, not 860px -- see T2 note), covered by the pre-existing global prefers-reduced-motion rule at the end of styles.css. Quick Contact: 2-col card layout, form uses contact-form-modern class + name/email/phone/message field names verified against contact-form-handler.js's collectFormData. Discovered index.html never loaded contact-form-handler.js/contact-analytics.js (it had no form before) -- added both script tags. contact-analytics.js's field-level tracking uses #name/#email/#phone/#message IDs but this form uses qc-* IDs to avoid clashing with any future second form on the page, so field-level analytics won't fire for this form (submit-level tracking is unaffected, gated by typeof checks that were already false everywhere). Verified via parcel build only, no live browser.

tasks.title: Homepage: remaining sections (stats, intro, services grid, work, testimonials, FAQ, final CTA, footer)
tasks.success: Remaining homepage sections rebuilt per spec order (stats bar with count-up, intro, 6-card services grid, work/case-studies grid, testimonials+trusted-by, FAQ accordion, Final CTA with no form linking to contact.html, shared footer applied); all real content (numbers/quotes/projects) sourced from current site, no invented figures.
tasks.verify: npm run dev; scroll through homepage, confirm count-up animation triggers on scroll into view, FAQ accordion opens/closes natively, Final CTA has no form and both buttons link correctly, footer matches the shared component.
tasks.notes: Also fixed a T1 gap discovered here: no global rule set h1/h2/h3 to Caprasimo, so headings sitewide were rendering in Figtree until this task added `h1,h2,h3 { font-family: var(--font-heading); }`. Stats bar uses 4 real, verifiable numbers (10+ yrs experience from product-development.html copy, 6 services, 5 client industries served, 24/7 support from the FAQ) -- no invented metrics. Services grid is new (homepage previously had no grid, just intro text); reused services.html's exact 6 titles/descriptions/icon paths verbatim, alternating accent/accent-2 tint per service (AI Agents/Product Dev/Digital Products=accent, Automation/Web Dev/Machine Learning=accent-2) -- this exact mapping needs to carry into T6 for cross-page consistency per spec. 'Work' section reuses the 5 real existing clients-showcase cards (Auto Trader, Stream, Order Fresh, Vapor Heaven, Vape Masters) instead of inventing case studies; no real project photos exist in assets/images so used icon/color blocks instead of a photo, skipping the mockup's washed-photo treatment rather than faking one. No real testimonial quotes exist anywhere on the site, so per the no-invention rule only the 'trusted-by' logo-strip half of section 7 was built (reusing the same 5 real client names) -- testimonials were omitted, not fabricated. FAQ content copied verbatim from contact.html's existing schema-marked Q&As, re-markup'd as native <details>/<summary> (no JS) per spec, leaving contact.html's own JS-driven FAQ untouched for T5. Final CTA already matched the no-form target state exactly, no changes needed. Verified via parcel build only, no live browser.

tasks.title: Interior pages re-skin: About / Contact / Services / Team
tasks.success: 4 pages keep existing content/structure, get shared header/footer, Caprasimo headings, .card-based content, warm-cream hero band with accent highlight text; contact.html's full 7-field form restyled to .field/.input/.btn-primary with unchanged fields/behavior.
tasks.verify: npm run dev; load each of the 4 pages, confirm header/footer consistent with homepage, no layout breakage, contact.html form fields present and handler binds.
tasks.notes: Much of this task was already achieved globally by T1 (colors/fonts/icons sitewide) and T2 (shared header/footer everywhere), since headings, body text, and nav/footer are the same shared CSS classes on every page. Remaining page-specific work done here: contact.html's form inputs/selects switched to pill/rounded radius via var(--radius-pill)/var(--radius-md) on the existing .contact-form-modern input/select/textarea rule (kept the existing .form-group markup rather than renaming to .field, to avoid a specificity fight with that already-working descendant selector); added an accent-colored highlight span to the About/Team/Contact hero H1s (services.html already had one via its existing .gradient-text span, which auto-updated when --gradient-text was remapped in T1). Did not force existing bespoke card-like blocks (about-features, team-member, form-group) into the new .card class -- risk of visual breakage without a way to see the rendered result outweighed the benefit, since their own existing CSS already inherits the new color tokens correctly. Verified via parcel build only, no live browser.
